structure.unit: General Provisions; Charters; Other Forms and Organization of Counties
Urban County Executive Form of Government

law.catch_line: City may petition to become part of county
law.text: After the date of adoption of the urban county executive form of government, a city contiguous to or within the limits of such a county may petition, by action of its governing body, to become a part of the county on terms set forth in a resolution adopted by the board. Passage of a referendum within the petitioning city shall constitute approval of the city becoming a district of the county or a part or parts of one or more districts and action of the board shall constitute final approval thereof by the county.
